Top-level, pure-presentational test runner: a summary/filter header over a resizable tree + detail split. All data and handlers flow in via props and are exposed to sub-components through a single `TestRunnerContext`. Domain rendering is pluggable via node adapters; no fetch/SSE/routing lives here.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/test-runner/TestRunner.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { TestRunner } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
